MSGID/GENADMIN/ARMY MARS REGION FOUR ADMIN OFFICER/9//
SUBJ/TIPS FOR SEARCHING THE NEW ADRESS BOOKS IN MESSAGE CREATOR //
GENTEXT/REMARKS/

BY NOW, WE HAVE HOPEFULLY DOWNLOADED THE NEW GLOBAL, AMARS AND RGN
ADDRESS BOOKS.
YOU WILL NOTE THAT THERE HAVE BEEN SOME ORGANIZATION CHANGES.
BELOW ARE A FEW TIPS ON SEARCHING IN MESSAGE CREATOR:
1.USE THE PLA TO SEARCH. THE PREFIXES ARE CONSISTENT THROUGHOUT ALL
ADDRESS BOOKS
2.USE THE PREFIX AMARS STATION FOLLOWED BY THE STATIONS CALL SIGN
FOR INDIVIDUAL STATIONS
A. EXAMPLE: AMARS STATION AAR4DT
2.THE FOLLOWING GROUP PLAS ARE AVAILABLE:
A. ALL REGION FOUR MARS FOR N7X (GLOBAL_AB)
B. ALL REGION FOUR AMARS FOR B7Q (AMARS_AB)
C. ALL AMARS REGION FOUR 1PLT FOR 1ST PLATOON, FORMERLY ALPHA
(AMARS_AB)
D. ALL AMARS REGION FOUR 2PLT FOR 2ND PLATOON, FORMERLY BRAVO
(AMARS_AB)
3.USE THE PREFIX AMARS REGION FOUR FOLLOWED BY THE BILLET TITLE FOR
COMMAND AND STAFF POSITIONS.
THEY ARE LISTED IN BOTH THE AMARS AND RGN ADDRESS BOOKS.
A. EXAMPLE: AMARS REGION FOUR ADMIN OFFICER (AMARS_AB)
B. EXAMPLE: AMARS REGION FOUR 1PLT LDR (AMARS_AB)
C. EXAMPLE: AMARS REGION FOUR 1PLT ADMIN OFFICER (RGN_AB)
D. EXAMPLE: AMARS REGION FOUR 1PLT TRAINING OFFICER (RGN_AB)
4.THE FOLLOWING MESSAGE CENTERS ARE AVAILABLE (GLOBAL_AB):
A. MARS REG FOUR MNR RLY AND MSG CNTR FOR NEARSIDEKAPPA
B. REGION FOUR RJMOG FOR KAPPA MAIN
C. MARS REG FOUR TRIB STN AND MSG CNTR A FOR KAPPA71
D. MARS REG FOUR TRIB STN AND MSG CNTR B FOR KAPPA72//
